messages:
anya: Quick heads-up — planning a controlled toggle for enable_predictive_batching tonight during the 22:00-23:00 UTC quiet window. Need: deploy owner, smoke checklist, and rollback ready. Leaving it as a gradual handshake (canary -> 50% -> full).

mike: I can watch dashboards. who actually runs the toggle? also confirm timezone: 22:00 UTC is 6pm ET, correct? :calendar:

anya: yes 22:00 UTC = 6pm ET. we want jamal to run but mike please own monitoring and escalation.

jamal: I got it. plan: canary 10% for 15m -> 50% for 15m -> 100%. smoke: the /health/predictive-batcher endpoint + p50/p95 latency, error-rate, and queue depth. rollback threshold = error-rate > 2% OR p95 +30% over baseline.

sophia: +1. Also make sure safe-default is set (fallback to disabled for EU tenant group) in case of partial regression. who will update the safe-default if we need it mid-window?

jamal: I can toggle the EU safe-default as a fallback. Commands I'll run:

```bash
# flip canary on 10%
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/toggles/enable_predictive_batching/flip" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"target":"canary","pct":10}'

# rollback to disabled
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.internal/toggles/enable_predictive_batching/flip" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"target":"all","state":false}'
```

jamal: quick local smoke to run after flip:
`curl -sS https://predictive.api.redwood/health | jq .status` and a sample inference check with a short prompt to verify no latency spike.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: toggle job queued by jamal for 2026-05-14T22:00:00Z (id: tg-9843). Will post start/finish events.

mike: I'll be at the desk 21:45-23:30 UTC. I'll watch Grafana -> redwood/latency, redwood/errors, and the canary cohort dashboard. ping me in this thread if you need a rollback.

anya: handoff: jamal will run, mike watches, sophia will validate safe-defaults and EU fallback, and I'll coordinate with oncall if we need wider ops.

jamal: checklist before flip (quick):
- ensure rolling keyspace cleared
- verify DB migration not in flight
- confirm model variant pinned
- pre-warm KV cache for 5m
- set canary=10%

sophia: noted. adding: notify customer-facing triage (channel #support-watch) once 50% reached.

anya: final: if metrics exceed rollback threshold, jamal will run the rollback command and mike will escalate to #eng-oncall and page ops. otherwise we'll promote at +15m steps. :white_check_mark:

mike: ACK :thumbsup:

sophia: ACK :thumbsup:

jamal: ACK, will post timestamps and the job id when I start.

anya: thanks all — keeping this short. i'll update runbook with the canary percentages and thresholds after this message.
